description: Traders of our latest Monthly Report for an exposure level (advanced uses risque's list). Rule: each more prudent level's suggestion is set aside first (prudent, then equilibre); then, among the level's #3 to #5 not set aside, the one who opened the most positions in the 30 days before the report is suggested (a tie goes to the better rank), never #1 or #2; if #3 to #5 were all set aside, the most active of them anyway. One suggestion per level, for every account: three traders of the report in all; the full lists are in get_report with a paid plan. risque strongly recommends 2 leaders: choose the second one yourself. The answer's top-level fields are the suggestion and suggestions repeats it: address, rank, winRatePct, profitFactor, tradesPerMonth, medianHoldHours, note, liveCheck. Report figures are month-end: before choosing, check the trader's current positions with get_leader_positions. Then pass the address to set_copy_settings; changeable any time. Error no_suggestion: no report published yet.
name: suggest_leader
title: Suggested traders for a level
